issues.on_page: Visitors Promotion Fund / Visitors Improvement Fund, Taxes: Other 10,901 + 10,901
issues.issue: Tax type comes from the fund name (allowed by the 2026-11-04 fund-name rule), but the row is printed 'Other', not 'Lodging'. The rule says a printed tax-type label beats a fund name, so a person should confirm that 'Other' here is generic and doesn't name a tax type. The same applies to detail[43] (21,802). Arithmetic is exact: 21,802 + 103,386 = 125,188.
